cases.name: Hiltrud A. "Hiltie" Muenzel
cases.about:
She and her husband were long-time residents of Trails End Mobile Manor. They moved there in the mid-1970s and managed the property up until last year. “They were the park, they would be the most important people that held everything together here if you were doing something wrong you got a notice if you were in a struggle in your life they were there to help you,” Keith Barber, co-owner of the Trails End Mobile Manor said.
